name: Test Keyed API
description: A v0.2 test API that issues free API keys through a v0.2 payment block. It mirrors how BakeBase declares key provisioning and exists to prove v0.2 payment blocks validate against the v0.2 schema.

endpoints.description: List ingredients with their functional properties for baking.
endpoints.response_description: Returns a JSON array of ingredients with names and functional roles.

authentication.instructions: No account required. POST to /dashboard/keys to generate a key, then send it as X-API-Key.

agent_notes: No account required. Get an api key from /dashboard/keys and send it in the X-API-Key header for authentication. Pricing is free up to 10,000 queries per day.
